# Frontend Page Instructions

## Purpose
Render accessible UI surfaces using hooks for data retrieval & state. Maintain separation from HTTP concerns.

## Artifacts
- `<entity>-list.page.tsx`
- `<entity>-details.page.tsx`

## Structure Guidelines
| Concern | Rule |
|---------|------|
| Effects | Single effect to trigger initial load if list empty |
| Layout | Use shared `<PageHeader/>`, `<PageContainer/>`, `<PageFooter/>` components |
| Accessibility | Headings in logical order, aria labels for interactive controls |
| State | Local component state only for transient UI (modals, selections) |

## List Page Skeleton
```tsx
export function <Entity>ListPage() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<T<Entity>DTO[]>([]);
  const { notifyAdapter, <entity>Adapter } = useAdapters();
  const { execute: loadItems, isExecuting: isLoading } =
    useGetEntityList<TMapDTO>(ENTITY_ENUM.MAP, notifyAdapter, mapAdapter);

  const handlerGetList = useCallback(async () => {
    const response = await loadItems();

    if (response.success) {
      setItems(response.data);
    }
  }, [loadItems]);

  useEffect(() => {
    handlerGetList();
  }, [handlerGetList]);

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="page.<entity>.list.title"
        description="page.<entity>.list.description"
        actions={[
          // define actions here. Ex:
          {
            label: 'page.map-list.button.create-map',
            icon: 'map-plus',
            onPress: showModal,
          },
        ]}
        breadCrumbs={[
          // define breadCrumbs here. Ex:
          {
            icon: <IconifyWrapper icon="home" />,
            key: 'home',
            href: ROUTES.DASHBOARD.BASE,
            title: 'page.header.breadcrumbs.home',
          },
          {
            key: 'map',
            title: 'Maps',
          },
        ]}
      />

      <PageContainer>
        <CustomTable items={items} loading={isExecuting} />

        <CustomModal
          name={MODAL_ENUM.CREATE_MAP}
          title="page.map-list.form.create-map.title"
          size="lg"
        >
          <FormCreateMap />
        </CustomModal>
      </PageContainer>
      <PageFooter />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Detail Page Notes
- Accept `uuid` param from router; call `useFind<Entity>ByUUID`
